gav_effect: No GAV effect from this verdict. The reviewed source-only row is a higher-level Ivy Hill total, while production holdings already contain the position-level Ivy Hill member interest and subordinated revolving loan.

primary_justification: The source-only row Ivy Hill Asset Management, L.P. has fair value 1,954.2M and is not a separate production position. Current production holdings for the same CIK/date include Ivy Hill Asset Management, L.P., Member interest at 1,926.2M and Ivy Hill Asset Management, L.P., Subordinated revolving loan at 28.0M, which sum to the source-only amount. The bundled HTML evidence also shows the 1,954.2 row as a summary-style Ivy Hill row and separately shows the subordinated revolving loan as a position row. Adding the short Ivy Hill label would duplicate exposure.
residual_risk: This verdict does not create a global many-to-one clearing rule. A deterministic future rule would need exact same-CIK/date fair-value summation and borrower identity checks before treating other short plain identifiers as non-blocking.
reviewer_notes: No production patch is proposed. The existing position-level output is more granular than the source-only Ivy Hill label, and the short source label is a duplicate aggregate of existing Ivy Hill component positions.
source_reconciliation_effect: No production row should be added for the reviewed Ivy Hill short label. It is intentionally non-blocking when documented as a borrower/investee total equal to existing component holdings.
